messages.content: The inspected contract requires rejecting an interior start (offset inside a surrogate pair), which the current subject.mjs fails to do. I'll propose the fix while preserving all other behavior.
messages.reasoning_content:
Current subject.mjs handles most, but issues: interior start offset should be rejected ("reject an interior start"). Current code doesn't reject interior start. Add check: if splitPair(offset) reject. Also "Reject a nonempty read that cannot make progress" — current: need(end>offset||offset===text.length). With max_chars>=1 and end>offset unless splitPair decrement... actually if end=offset+1 pair-split, end-- gives end=offset → reject nonempty. Fine.

Add interior start rejection.
